title: Publication Pilot 1 Candidate Output Envelope
description: Provider-neutral parsed candidate artifact for Publication Pilot 1. The pipeline wraps the model semantic payload with request/run metadata before validation. Validation outcomes are stored separately and are not authored by the model.

sourceArtifactID.description: Exact copy of sourceUnit.canonicalArtifactID for the publication artifact.

metadata.description: Pipeline-owned request and run binding. These values are copied from trusted request/run records rather than accepted from the model as semantic evidence.

labelMode.description: The authoritative candidate label is always the exact source-grounded surface form. Normalized labels are represented only as non-authoritative proposals.

normalizedLabelProposal.description: Optional non-authoritative normalization proposed from the evidence-grounded label. It is not evidence and may not be used for identity, linking, merging, or consolidation unless separately validated or adjudicated.

candidateNode.description: One proposed or linked publication node candidate.

candidateEdge.description: One proposed publication relation candidate with edge-specific evidence.

sourceArtifactID.description: Exact copy of sourceUnit.canonicalArtifactID for the publication artifact.

sectionTitle.description: Exact copy of sourceUnit.sectionTitleRaw; null for the synthetic front-matter section. The routing-only sectionTitleNormalized is not evidence.

evidenceHash.description: Pipeline-computed SHA-256 of UTF-8(evidenceText); null before evidence validation.

evidenceSpan.description: One contiguous evidence span. A span may not cross a source-unit boundary.

abstention.description: Explicit semantic abstention for a plausible task. Absence of a candidate is not automatically an abstention, and processing failures are represented elsewhere.

deferredRecordResolution.description: Non-authoritative disposition proposed for one deterministic Phase B deferred record. The proposal is validated separately and is not an adjudication or graph-acceptance outcome.
